purpose: LRM 5.10.3.1 cross(): the timestep is controlled so the crossing resolves to time_tol

oracle.derivation: PWL(0 0 1m 1) is a straight 1 V/ms ramp, so v(in) = 1000*t exactly and the threshold v(in) = 0.5 V is reached at t = 5e-4 s exactly. 5.10.3.1 requires the event after that instant and inside the box set by time_tol, which the model writes as 1e-6 s, so the latched output is 0 V for every t < 5e-4 and 1 V for every t >= 5.01e-4. The two samples straddle that window with margin: 4.99e-4 is 1 us before the crossing (expect 0 V) and 5.02e-4 is 2 us after it, twice time_tol (expect 1 V). The deck's own step ceiling is min(tstep 1e-4, (tstop-tstart)/50 = 2e-5), so a simulator that does not shorten the step for the crossing latches somewhere in [5e-4, 5.2e-4] and reads an interpolated value between 0 and 1 at the second sample.
